title.en: Granting Incentive and Other Allowances to Certain Personnel of the Philippine Atomic Energy Commission and Providing Funds Therefor

text.en:
All officials and professional, scientific and technical personnel of the Philippine Atomic Energy
Commission actively engaged in the different activities related to the nuclear power program shall receive
monthly incentive allowance at rates in accordance with the following categories:
(a) The PAEC Commissioner shall receive a commutable monthly incentive allowance of P2,500 and
reimbursable representation and transportation expenses of P250 each per month;
(b) The Deputy Commissioner shall receive a commutable monthly incentive allowance of P2,000 a month
and reimbursable representation and transportation expenses of P250 each per month;
(c) All other professional, scientific and technical personnel shall receive monthly commutable incentive
allowances not exceeding P1,500 a month but not less than P500 a month and reimbursable representation and

transportation expenses each not exceeding P200 a month in accordance with graduated scales to be
established by the PAEC Commissioner.

The PAEC Commissioner shall establish guidelines in the determination of position and salary
grouping personnel entitled to these allowances and reimbursable expenses with appropriate safeguards to
insure equitable distribution of these incentives.

To carry out the provisions of this Decree for the calendar year 1977, the sum of One Million
Five Hundred Thousand Pesos (P1,500,000.00) is hereby appropriated and released to the Philippine Atomic
Energy Commission from the President's Special Activities Fund. Thereafter the same amount needed to carry
out the provisions of this Decree shall be provided from assessed contributions of the National Power
Corporation and the Energy Development Board in the amounts of One Million Pesos (P1,000,000.00) and
Five Hundred Thousand Pesos (P500,000.00) respectively. The amounts to be contributed by these agencies
shall be included in their respective annual budgets.

All laws, rules and regulations in contravention herewith are hereby modified or superseded
accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
